method: Continuous native Blender camera, rendered with Three.js PBR building materials, diffuse context/foliage, and static street-light pool decals. Foliage uses a documented animation LOD; architecture is not decimated. The Cycles daylight still is the detailed material reference.
encoding_note: The initial JPEG-pipe encode retained full-range BT.601 metadata. This delivered file was converted once to limited-range BT.709 at CRF 16. The capture recipe now performs that conversion before its first encode.
